description: find_immutable_patch_key builds the immutable-fields HashSet once via OnceLock::get_or_init and reuses it on every call (O(1) lookup per key). The subsequent linear scan over IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS is only for returning a &'static str canonical name, which is done at most once per violation. A future contributor might simplify to a linear scan for all lookups (O(n) per key); for 23 fields this is fine in practice but the OnceLock pattern is correct and worth preserving for correctness-by-construction.
title: find_immutable_patch_key uses OnceLock<HashSet> for O(1) per-call lookup
